primaryExample: Hang your coat on the hook beside the door so that it does not get wet on the floor.
primaryTranslation: 把外套挂在门旁的钩子上，免得放在地上弄湿。

english: a hollow metal object shaped like a cup that rings when it is hit
primaryExample: The bell rang just as we reached the gate, reminding us that the first lesson was about to begin.
primaryTranslation: 我们刚到校门铃就响了，提醒我们第一节课即将开始。

english: basic state of things that is similar to water; not solid or gas
primaryExample: Pour the liquid slowly into the container, watching the mark on the side so that it does not overflow.
primaryTranslation: 把液体慢慢倒进容器，并注意侧面刻度，避免溢出。

english: overwhelming feeling of fear and anxiety
primaryExample: Despite the sudden noise, the guide showed no sign of panic and calmly led everyone towards the exit.
primaryTranslation: 尽管响声突然，导游没有显露惊慌，而是冷静地带大家走向出口。

english: brother of your father or mother or the husband of your aunt
primaryExample: My uncle offered to repair the shelf, but he also showed me how to do the job myself next time.
primaryTranslation: 叔叔主动提出修架子，也教我下次如何自己修。

english: white or brown grains from a plant used for food
primaryExample: We cooked enough rice for the extra guests and kept the rest of the meal simple to avoid wasting food.
primaryTranslation: 我们煮了足够的米饭给额外的客人，其余饭菜从简，以免浪费食物。

english: an area of land that is higher on one side than the other
primaryExample: The slope became steeper beyond the trees, so we slowed down and checked that everyone was still comfortable.
primaryTranslation: 树林后面的坡变陡了，因此我们放慢速度，并确认大家仍能适应。

english: state of feeling pleased; feeling of satisfaction
primaryExample: She found that helping with the community garden brought a kind of happiness that buying new things rarely gave her.
primaryTranslation: 她发现帮忙打理社区花园带来的幸福，是买新东西很少能给予的。

english: being real, actual, and not false
primaryExample: The letter expressed genuine thanks, mentioning small acts of kindness that the volunteers themselves had almost forgotten.
primaryTranslation: 信里表达了真诚的感谢，提到一些志愿者自己都快忘记的小小善举。

english: 1. a ship; 2. a tube that carries liquid in an animal or plant; 3. a container
primaryExample: The wooden vessel remained in the harbour until the crew had checked the weather and loaded enough supplies.
primaryTranslation: 船员检查天气并装好足够物资后，那艘木船才离开港口。

english: word that expresses an action or state
primaryExample: The teacher asked us to choose a more precise verb so that readers could picture exactly how the character moved.
primaryTranslation: 老师让我们选一个更准确的动词，让读者能清楚想象角色如何移动。

english: to believe that something is true or possible; to calculate or guess
primaryExample: I reckon we can finish the display before lunch if everyone takes responsibility for one small section.
primaryTranslation: 我估计，如果每个人负责一小部分，我们能在午饭前完成展板。

english: lacking seriousness or foolish
primaryExample: It seemed silly to carry an umbrella in sunshine, but we were grateful for it when the weather changed.
primaryTranslation: 晴天带伞看起来傻，但天气变化后我们庆幸带了它。

english: act, system, or business of moving people or goods from one place to another
primaryExample: Reliable transportation is important for the village because many residents travel to the nearest town for work and shopping.
primaryTranslation: 可靠的交通对村庄很重要，因为许多居民去最近的城镇工作和购物。

english: area of water protected by land and used by ships
primaryExample: The fishing boats returned to the harbor before the storm arrived, while the last visitors hurried towards the town.
primaryTranslation: 暴风雨到来前渔船返回港口，最后一批游客也匆忙往镇上走。

english: light or funny play or film, usually with a happy ending
primaryExample: We chose a comedy for the film evening because everyone wanted something cheerful after a demanding week at work.
primaryTranslation: 我们为电影之夜选了部喜剧，因为忙碌的一周工作后大家都想轻松开心一下。

english: to follow and try to catch someone or something
primaryExample: The children watched the dog chase a ball across the grass, then bring it proudly back to its owner.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们看狗追着球跑过草地，再得意地把球叼回主人身边。

english: a safe place to keep something until it is needed
primaryExample: The school needs more storage for art materials, which are currently kept in boxes along the classroom wall.
primaryTranslation: 学校需要更多空间存放美术材料，这些材料目前装在教室墙边的箱子里。

english: all of space and everything in it
primaryExample: The exhibition invites visitors to consider how small our planet is compared with the vast scale of the universe.
primaryTranslation: 展览邀请参观者思考，与宇宙的广阔规模相比，我们的星球多么渺小。

english: very unpleasant
primaryExample: The weather was horrible when we arrived, but a warm welcome at the guesthouse soon improved everyone's mood.
primaryTranslation: 我们到达时天气糟透了，但旅馆的热情欢迎很快让大家心情变好。

english: farm animal kept for meat and wool
primaryExample: A flock of sheep blocked the narrow road, so we waited patiently while the farmer guided them towards the field.
primaryTranslation: 一群羊挡住窄路，我们耐心等待农场主把它们赶向田地。

english: a person who likes someone or something very strongly
primaryExample: As a nature lover, she preferred a quiet holiday near the forest to staying in a busy city hotel.
primaryTranslation: 作为大自然爱好者，她更喜欢在林边安静度假，而不是住繁忙城市的酒店。

english: an animal that looks like a large mouse
primaryExample: The guide pointed out where a rat had left tiny tracks in the dust near the old storehouse.
primaryTranslation: 导游指出，老仓库旁灰尘中哪些地方留有老鼠的小脚印。

english: painting, drawing, or photograph of a person's head and shoulders
primaryExample: The portrait shows her grandmother as a young woman, long before the family moved to the coastal town.
primaryTranslation: 这幅肖像描绘祖母年轻时的模样，那时全家尚未搬到海边小镇。

english: not having done anything wrong or bad
primaryExample: The boy was innocent of breaking the window, as a neighbour's photograph showed he had been elsewhere at the time.
primaryTranslation: 男孩没有打破窗户，邻居的照片证明他当时在别处。

english: person or thing that takes the place of something
primaryExample: Yoghurt can be a useful substitute for cream in this recipe, although it gives the sauce a different flavour.
primaryTranslation: 这道菜可以用酸奶代替奶油，但酱汁风味会有所不同。

english: something added to another thing to make it better
primaryExample: The workbook is a useful supplement to the course, offering extra examples that students can study at their own pace.
primaryTranslation: 这本练习册为课程提供有益补充，额外例子可让学生按自己的节奏学习。

english: a small change to make something function better
primaryExample: A small adjustment to the chair's height made the desk more comfortable to use during long writing sessions.
primaryTranslation: 椅子高度稍作调整后，长时间写作时用桌子更舒服了。

english: in a fair and just manner
primaryExample: The chair handled the complaint reasonably, listening to both sides before suggesting a solution that neither had considered.
primaryTranslation: 主席合理处理投诉，先听双方意见，再提出双方都未想到的方案。

english: device to remove unwanted substances from a liquid or gas
primaryExample: We replaced the filter when the water began flowing slowly, then checked that the machine was working normally again.
primaryTranslation: 水流变慢时我们换了过滤器，再检查机器是否恢复正常。

english: capable of being easily bent or changed without breaking
primaryExample: A flexible timetable allowed her to study in the evenings while still meeting her responsibilities at work and home.
primaryTranslation: 灵活的时间表让她能晚上学习，同时履行工作和家庭责任。

english: concerning something that doesn't exist physically
primaryExample: The teacher used a familiar example to make the abstract idea easier for younger students to understand.
primaryTranslation: 老师用熟悉的例子，让抽象概念对低龄学生更容易理解。

english: portable cloth shelter used outdoors
primaryExample: We put up the tent before it got dark, making sure the entrance faced away from the wind.
primaryTranslation: 我们天黑前搭好帐篷，并确保入口背风。

english: very accurate and exact expression or detail
primaryExample: Give precise directions to the meeting point, because several paths cross near the entrance and could confuse visitors.
primaryTranslation: 请准确说明去集合点的路线，因为入口附近有几条小路交叉，可能让访客困惑。

english: existing or happening far away in space
primaryExample: The distant mountains became clearer as the morning mist lifted, revealing a narrow line of snow along the highest ridge.
primaryTranslation: 晨雾散去时远山更清晰，最高山脊上显露出一条细细的雪带。

english: someone you do not know
primaryExample: A stranger noticed that we were lost and kindly explained how to reach the station without crossing the busy road.
primaryTranslation: 一位陌生人发现我们迷路，友善地解释如何不穿过繁忙马路就到达车站。

english: (v) to make (n) an area of darkness where something stops the light
primaryExample: We moved into the shade beneath a large tree while the guide explained the next part of the walk.
primaryTranslation: 导游讲解下一段步行路线时，我们移到一棵大树下的阴凉处。

english: seeds of plants used for food
primaryExample: The farm stores grain in large dry buildings to protect it from rain before it is transported to market.
primaryTranslation: 农场把粮食存放在干燥的大建筑里，避免运往市场前被雨淋。

english: to place someone or something in a particular place or position
primaryExample: The designers chose to situate the reading room beside the garden, where natural light could enter throughout the day.
primaryTranslation: 设计师选择把阅览室设在花园旁，让自然光全天照入。

english: to state the main or most important ideas of something
primaryExample: Try to summarize the article in your own words before deciding whether its evidence supports the main conclusion.
primaryTranslation: 先试着用自己的话概括文章，再判断证据是否支持主要结论。

english: (v) to (n) jump high or far
primaryExample: The dog made a sudden leap across the stream while we searched for a safer place to step over.
primaryTranslation: 我们寻找更安全的过溪落脚点时，狗突然一跃跳过了溪流。

english: (v) to make the sound of (n) a sudden sharp break
primaryExample: The dry branch began to snap under his weight, so he stepped back before trying a different route.
primaryTranslation: 枯树枝在他的重量下开始折裂，于是他后退再换路走。

english: what the chances are that something will happen
primaryExample: The forecast gives a high probability of rain, but we should still check the conditions before leaving tomorrow.
primaryTranslation: 预报说下雨概率很高，但明天出发前我们仍应查看天气情况。

english: a material made from the skin of an animal
primaryExample: She chose a leather bag that could be repaired easily, hoping to use it for many years rather than replace it often.
primaryTranslation: 她选了个容易修理的皮包，希望能用多年，不必经常更换。

english: feeling that you don't really know what will happen
primaryExample: There was considerable uncertainty about the opening date, so we waited for an official notice before booking our journey.
primaryTranslation: 开幕日期有很大不确定性，因此我们等官方通知后才预订行程。

english: (v) to make (n) a serious promise to do something
primaryExample: I swear I left the keys beside the door, although I cannot explain why they are no longer there.
primaryTranslation: 我发誓把钥匙放在门边了，但说不清它们为何不见了。

english: a person who ran away from his or her country because of war
primaryExample: The refugee joined a language class where volunteers helped new arrivals understand local services and build connections with neighbours.
primaryTranslation: 那位难民参加语言班，志愿者帮助新来者了解当地服务并与邻居建立联系。

english: land along the edge of an area of water
primaryExample: We walked along the shore after breakfast, collecting photographs of the changing light rather than taking shells home.
primaryTranslation: 早餐后我们沿岸散步，拍下光线变化的照片，而没有带贝壳回家。

english: occurring twelve times a year
primaryExample: The group meets monthly to review its spending and decide which community activities should receive support during the next period.
primaryTranslation: 小组每月开会审查开支，并决定下一阶段支持哪些社区活动。

english: to make up or form something
primaryExample: The exhibition will comprise photographs, personal letters, and short recordings that together tell the story of the neighbourhood.
primaryTranslation: 展览将由照片、私人信件和短录音组成，共同讲述这个街区的故事。

english: to mix something by making circular movements in it with a tool
primaryExample: Stir the mixture gently until it becomes smooth, then leave it to cool before adding the final ingredient.
primaryTranslation: 轻轻搅拌混合物至顺滑，放凉后再加入最后一种食材。

english: when people feel very happy and enthusiastic
primaryExample: The children's excitement grew as the train approached the coast and the first stretch of blue sea appeared.
primaryTranslation: 火车驶近海岸，第一片蓝色海面出现时，孩子们越来越兴奋。

english: to breathe out in a way to show boredom or disappointment
primaryExample: She gave a long sigh when the printer stopped again, then calmly looked for another way to share the document.
primaryTranslation: 打印机再次停机时，她长叹一声，然后冷静寻找其他分享文档的方法。

english: time when a female is going to have a baby
primaryExample: During her pregnancy, she discussed her changing routine with her family so they could plan how to support one another.
primaryTranslation: 怀孕期间，她与家人讨论日常变化，以便安排如何彼此支持。

english: using techniques that are different or untried before
primaryExample: The school introduced an experimental timetable for one term before asking students and teachers whether the changes had helped.
primaryTranslation: 学校试行了一个学期的新课表，再询问师生这些变化是否有帮助。

english: concerning a large organization such as a hospital or university
primaryExample: Institutional support gave the project stability, although the organisers still relied on volunteers to run the weekly sessions.
primaryTranslation: 机构支持使项目保持稳定，但组织者仍依靠志愿者开展每周活动。

english: a flat piece of food that has been cut from a bigger piece
primaryExample: She cut a thin slice of bread for each guest before placing the warm soup on the table.
primaryTranslation: 她给每位客人切了一片薄面包，再把热汤端上桌。

english: to move around without purpose
primaryExample: We decided to wander through the old town without a map, stopping whenever a small shop caught our attention.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定不看地图在老城漫步，只要小店吸引了注意就停下来。

english: group of countries controlled by one government
primaryExample: The museum explains how the empire expanded, but it also describes the experiences of communities brought under its rule.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆解释帝国如何扩张，也描述被纳入其统治的群体的经历。

english: after something else has happened
primaryExample: The workshop was initially offered to one class and subsequently expanded after teachers reported that students found it useful.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊最初只面向一个班，老师反映学生觉得有用后，随后扩大了范围。

english: kind and quiet in nature; not harsh or violent
primaryExample: The guide's gentle manner helped the nervous children relax before they entered the dark section of the cave.
primaryTranslation: 导游温和的态度让紧张的孩子在进入洞穴的黑暗区域前放松下来。

english: state of being present at a place or event
primaryExample: Attendance at the evening classes improved once the centre offered sessions that fitted around parents' working hours.
primaryTranslation: 中心开设与家长工作时间相协调的课程后，晚课出勤率提高了。

english: legal right to have something belong to you
primaryExample: The documents confirm ownership of the house, which must be established before any major changes can be approved.
primaryTranslation: 这些文件确认房屋所有权，在批准重大改动前必须先确定这一点。

english: official record proving a certain standard or level
primaryExample: The course leads to a recognised qualification, although students must complete practical work as well as a final examination.
primaryTranslation: 该课程可获得认可资质，但学生除期末考试外还必须完成实践作业。

english: to stop something for a period of time; to interrupt
primaryExample: The club decided to suspend outdoor training until the damaged field could be repaired and checked for safety.
primaryTranslation: 俱乐部决定暂停户外训练，直到受损场地修复并通过安全检查。

english: useful; not just for decoration
primaryExample: The room is small but functional, with enough space for reading, working, and storing the equipment we use regularly.
primaryTranslation: 房间虽小却实用，有足够空间阅读、工作和存放常用设备。

english: done or given by their own will and not forced to do
primaryExample: Participation in the weekend project is voluntary, so students can decide whether it fits their interests and other commitments.
primaryTranslation: 周末项目自愿参加，学生可以判断是否符合自己的兴趣和其他安排。

english: light in color
primaryExample: The pale blue walls made the room feel brighter, especially when sunlight came through the window in the afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 浅蓝墙壁让房间更明亮，尤其是午后阳光从窗户照进来时。

english: to mark or change the color of something so it looks dirty
primaryExample: Be careful not to stain the cloth with paint, since we need to use it again for the next display.
primaryTranslation: 注意别让油漆弄脏布料，因为下次展示还要用它。

english: person trained to compete in sports
primaryExample: The young athlete learned that rest and consistent practice mattered more than trying to improve everything in a single week.
primaryTranslation: 这位年轻运动员学到，休息和持续练习比试图一周内提升一切更重要。

english: concerning food made with few or no chemicals
primaryExample: The shop sells organic vegetables from nearby farms and explains how each grower produces the food on display.
primaryTranslation: 商店出售附近农场的有机蔬菜，并介绍各农户如何种植所售食品。

english: part of the mouth that tastes food and is used for speaking
primaryExample: The teacher showed how the position of the tongue changes when we pronounce two sounds that seem similar at first.
primaryTranslation: 老师展示了发出两个起初听起来相似的音时，舌头位置如何变化。

english: a person or thing that brings things to you when asked to
primaryExample: The server noticed that our table needed water and returned with a fresh jug before we had to ask.
primaryTranslation: 服务员注意到我们这桌需要水，在我们开口前就端来一壶清水。

english: related to the way something is built or organized
primaryExample: The engineer found a structural problem in the bridge, so repairs began before it was opened to the public.
primaryTranslation: 工程师发现桥有结构问题，因此在向公众开放前就开始修理。

english: (web + site) a set of internet pages that give information about a particular person or organization
primaryExample: The museum's website lists current exhibitions and explains which activities visitors should book before arriving at the building.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆网站列出当前展览，并说明哪些活动需要游客到馆前预约。

english: a stupid or silly person
primaryExample: I felt like a fool when I realised I had been waiting at the wrong entrance for half an hour.
primaryTranslation: 意识到自己在错误入口等了半小时，我觉得自己像个傻瓜。

english: side by side with something
primaryExample: We walked alongside the river until the path turned towards a small village surrounded by fields and old stone walls.
primaryTranslation: 我们沿河并行，直到小路转向一个四周有田野和古石墙的小村庄。

english: to join or come together as one
primaryExample: The shared garden helped unite neighbours who had rarely met, giving them a reason to work towards a common goal.
primaryTranslation: 共享花园让很少见面的邻居团结起来，有理由为共同目标合作。

english: in a mild, careful, and soft manner
primaryExample: She gently lifted the old photograph from its envelope, taking care not to bend the fragile edges.
primaryTranslation: 她轻轻从信封里取出老照片，小心不折弯脆弱的边缘。

english: to find out by calculating or estimating
primaryExample: The program can compute the total cost quickly, but we still check whether all the necessary items were included.
primaryTranslation: 程序能快速算出总费用，但我们仍检查所有必需项目是否都包含在内。

english: to clean or dry something with a cloth
primaryExample: Wipe the table with a damp cloth before arranging the materials, so the paper stays clean during the activity.
primaryTranslation: 摆放材料前用湿布擦桌子，让活动中的纸保持干净。

english: odd or unusual
primaryExample: The old machine made a weird sound whenever it started, although the technician said it was working normally.
primaryTranslation: 老机器启动时总发出奇怪声音，不过技术员说它运转正常。

english: (v) to make (n) a long continuous look at someone or something
primaryExample: We paused to gaze at the night sky, which looked much clearer away from the lights of the town.
primaryTranslation: 我们停下来凝望夜空，远离城镇灯光后，天空显得清晰得多。

english: to lose strength or freshness
primaryExample: The colours began to fade after years in direct sunlight, so we moved the painting to a darker wall.
primaryTranslation: 多年受阳光直射后颜色开始褪去，于是我们把画移到较暗的墙上。

english: to force air through your throat with a short, loud noise
primaryExample: He began to cough during the speech, so the chair paused the session and offered him some water.
primaryTranslation: 他发言时开始咳嗽，于是主席暂停会议，递给他一些水。

english: idea that leads to further study or discussion
primaryExample: Our hypothesis was that plants near the window would grow faster, so we compared them with plants farther away.
primaryTranslation: 我们的假设是窗边植物长得更快，所以将它们与远离窗户的植物比较。

english: concerning a king or queen
primaryExample: The royal gardens are now open to visitors, although some parts remain reserved for official events during the summer.
primaryTranslation: 皇家花园现在向游客开放，但有些区域夏季仍留作官方活动之用。

english: involving the uncertain or yet to be proved parts of a particular subject
primaryExample: The course combines theoretical ideas with practical tasks, helping students see where a model works and where it needs adjustment.
primaryTranslation: 课程结合理论概念与实践任务，帮助学生看清模型在哪些地方有效、哪些地方需要调整。

english: piece of cloth used to cover a window
primaryExample: She pulled the curtain aside to let in more light before sitting down to finish her drawing.
primaryTranslation: 她拉开窗帘让更多光线进来，然后坐下完成画作。

english: head of a city's government
primaryExample: The mayor visited the new library to hear how residents hoped the space would support learning in the community.
primaryTranslation: 市长走访新图书馆，听取居民希望这个空间如何支持社区学习。

english: quality of no or little light
primaryExample: We waited for our eyes to adjust to the darkness before trying to find the path through the trees.
primaryTranslation: 我们先等眼睛适应黑暗，再试着找出穿过树林的小路。

chinese: 婶母；伯母；姑妈；姨妈，舅妈
english: sister of your father or mother or the wife of your uncle
primaryExample: My aunt keeps old family letters and sometimes reads them aloud when we ask about life before we were born.
primaryTranslation: 姑妈保存着家中旧信，有时会在我们问起出生前的生活时朗读给我们听。

english: a competition made up of a series of games between many competitors
primaryExample: The tournament brought teams from several towns together, giving younger players a chance to learn from more experienced opponents.
primaryTranslation: 锦标赛让几个城镇的球队聚在一起，让年轻球员有机会向更有经验的对手学习。

english: act of recording information on an official list
primaryExample: Complete your registration before Friday so that the organisers have enough time to prepare materials for everyone attending.
primaryTranslation: 请在周五前完成报名，让组织者有足够时间为所有参加者准备材料。

english: part that is broken off of something
primaryExample: A small fragment of the letter survived, giving historians a clue about who had lived in the house.
primaryTranslation: 信中留存的一小片，为历史学家提供了曾住在这所房子里的人的线索。

english: someone who pays attention to what is said
primaryExample: A good listener notices when someone needs time to think, rather than immediately filling every pause with advice.
primaryTranslation: 善于倾听的人会注意对方何时需要思考，而不是立刻用建议填满每次停顿。

english: the act of moving from one country to another for good
primaryExample: The exhibition explores immigration through personal objects that families carried with them when they began new lives abroad.
primaryTranslation: 展览通过家庭开始海外新生活时随身携带的物品来探索移民经历。

english: loving and gentle
primaryExample: Her tender words reassured the frightened child, who slowly began to describe what had happened on the way home.
primaryTranslation: 她温柔的话语安抚了受惊的孩子，孩子慢慢开始描述回家路上发生的事。

english: number of people or things in a particular area
primaryExample: The map shows population density, allowing us to compare crowded city centres with the more widely scattered rural communities.
primaryTranslation: 地图显示人口密度，让我们能比较拥挤市中心与分布更分散的乡村社区。

english: unpleasant to look at; not attractive
primaryExample: The ugly concrete wall looked less harsh after residents painted it with colourful scenes from the neighbourhood's history.
primaryTranslation: 居民在这堵难看的混凝土墙上画出街区历史的彩色场景后，它不再那么生硬。

english: part or unit with a specific job
primaryExample: Each module focuses on one practical skill, allowing learners to return to the areas they find most difficult.
primaryTranslation: 每个模块聚焦一项实用技能，让学习者能回头练习最困难的部分。

english: in a trustworthy manner
primaryExample: She faithfully recorded each stage of the project, making it easier for the next group to understand what had worked.
primaryTranslation: 她忠实记录项目每个阶段，让下一组更容易理解哪些方法有效。

english: season when the weather is getting colder, between summer and winter
primaryExample: In autumn, the path through the woods becomes colourful, although fallen leaves can make the stones slippery after rain.
primaryTranslation: 秋天林中小路色彩斑斓，但落叶可能让雨后的石头打滑。

english: soft skin on each side of the face, below the eyes
primaryExample: A cool breeze touched her cheek as she opened the window to listen to the birds outside.
primaryTranslation: 她打开窗听外面的鸟鸣时，一阵凉风拂过脸颊。

english: strong affection for someone
primaryExample: His attachment to the old house surprised him, since he had often complained about its small rooms and narrow stairs.
primaryTranslation: 他对老房子的依恋让自己都惊讶，因为他常抱怨房间小、楼梯窄。

english: person who owns or has received something
primaryExample: The ticket holder must show identification before collecting the pass that allows entry to the backstage area.
primaryTranslation: 持票人领取可进入后台区域的通行证前，必须出示身份证明。

english: to do with the sun, like sunlight or the heat from the sun
primaryExample: The school installed solar panels on the roof and used the project to teach students about different energy sources.
primaryTranslation: 学校在屋顶安装太阳能板，并以此项目教学生了解不同能源。

english: to smile a big smile
primaryExample: He could not help but grin when he realised that his friends had organised a surprise birthday picnic.
primaryTranslation: 意识到朋友们安排了一场生日惊喜野餐，他忍不住咧嘴笑了。

english: a red flower used to show love
primaryExample: She planted a rose beside the gate, hoping its flowers would welcome visitors each time they entered the garden.
primaryTranslation: 她在门旁种了一株玫瑰，希望花园每次迎客时都能看到它开花。

english: a word that refers to a person, place, thing, quality, idea, or action
primaryExample: The exercise asks you to replace the repeated noun with a pronoun so that the paragraph sounds more natural.
primaryTranslation: 练习要求用代词替换重复的名词，使段落更自然。

english: having good luck
primaryExample: We were fortunate to find an earlier train, which gave us time to explore the town before the concert.
primaryTranslation: 幸运的是我们找到更早的火车，于是演唱会前有时间游览小镇。

english: good; acceptable
primaryExample: The first attempt went alright, but we agreed that the opening could be clearer before the final presentation.
primaryTranslation: 第一次尝试还不错，但我们一致认为正式展示前还可以把开头说得更清楚。

english: not liking to work or make an effort
primaryExample: It would be lazy to repeat the old explanation without checking whether the new evidence supports it.
primaryTranslation: 不检查新证据是否支持就重复旧解释，是懒惰的做法。

english: what you say when you meet someone
primaryExample: She stopped to say hello to the new neighbour, then offered to explain when the local shops usually opened.
primaryTranslation: 她停下来向新邻居问好，再主动介绍当地商店通常何时开门。

english: feeling of needing to eat food
primaryExample: After hours of walking, our hunger made the simple meal taste better than anything we had eaten all week.
primaryTranslation: 走了几小时后，饥饿让这顿简单饭菜吃起来比整周吃过的都香。

english: to buy protection against possible loss or injury
primaryExample: They decided to insure the new equipment before lending it out, since replacing it would cost more than they could afford.
primaryTranslation: 他们决定先给新设备投保再外借，因为更换费用超出承受能力。

english: feeling shame or guilt because you did something wrong
primaryExample: She felt ashamed of blaming her friend before checking the facts, so she apologised as soon as she understood.
primaryTranslation: 她为没核实事实就责怪朋友感到羞愧，因此弄清后立刻道歉。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 为自己的行为感到羞愧

english: to start something such as a company or organization
primaryExample: They hope to found a community theatre where people of different ages can learn skills and create performances together.
primaryTranslation: 他们希望创办一个社区剧院，让不同年龄的人一起学技能、创作演出。

english: a website with regularly updated short articles and opinions about a particular topic
primaryExample: Her travel blog describes everyday encounters rather than famous sights, giving readers a more personal picture of each place.
primaryTranslation: 她的旅行博客描写日常见闻而非著名景点，让读者更个人化地了解各地。

english: need for something to drink
primaryExample: Cold water finally satisfied our thirst after the long climb, and we rested before continuing towards the viewpoint.
primaryTranslation: 长时间爬山后，凉水终于解了渴，我们休息后继续前往观景点。
